composition_variation: Portray an original 32-year-old anime woman with silver-gray shoulder-length hair, seated casually on broad architectural steps. She wears an opaque mustard trench coat over a black turtleneck and tailored trousers, with both feet resting naturally on a lower step. Use sophisticated gouache, charcoal and cream stone, warm sidelighting, and a self-assured half-smile. Her hands rest openly on her knees in a relaxed editorial pose. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.
